{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2019}}
{{main|2019 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''men's singles''' competition of the [[2019 World Table Tennis Championships]] was held from 23 to 28 April 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Liebherr 2019 World Table Tennis Championships / Schedule |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |website=ITTF |accessdate=22 January 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Entry list|url=https://oes.ittf.com/view/event/entries/e33449f4-4cc0-4383-b6a2-d151aa14e33c/detail|website=ITTF |accessdate=3 April 2019}}</ref>

[[Ma Long (table tennis)|Ma Long]] defended his title by defeating [[Mattias Falck]] 11–5, 11–7, 7–11, 11–9, 11–5 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|title=Ma Long for third time, joins legendary names|url=https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/28/ma-long-third-time-joins-legendary-names/|website=ITTF |date=28 April 2019 |accessdate=28 April 2019}}</ref>
